criteria.question: with transmitter sign included, does the gustatory sensory-to-motor map of MaleCNS encode valence (Tastekin, de Haan Vicente et al. 2026 computed it unsigned)?
criteria.source: Tastekin, de Haan Vicente et al. 2026, Cell 189:5527-5551 (valence assignments; their map is unsigned)

measure.kind: input-normalised path products: each neuron's incoming weights divided by its total absolute input, a unit vector on the source cells propagated hop by hop; influence on a motor neuron type is the sum over its cells
measure.signs: the model's edge signs (ACh +1; GABA, Glu, His -1; amines 0)

S1_valence_signed_on_proboscis.rule: point record: on the proboscis-extension MNs (mean over MN9 and MN6), the mean cumulative signed influence of LB3a-c is above 0 AND the mean of LB1a-d is below it

S2_per_type_sign_agreement.rule: point record: at least 5 of the 7 types LB3a-c, LB1a-d have cumulative signed influence on MN9 whose sign matches valence (appetitive > 0, bitter < 0)

S3_LB2_dominates_pharyngeal_pumping.rule: point record: LB2 (LB2a-d pooled) has the largest absolute cumulative signed influence on pharyngeal pumping (mean over MN11D and MN11V) among the labellar groups that have cells

criteria.reported: signed and unsigned tables, sign disagreement with the unsigned ranking, the LB3d glutamatergic counterfactual

electrical: shakB gap junction, 1:1 relay; Tanouye & Wyman 1980; Allen et al. 2006
shakB gap junction, 1:1 relay; Allen et al. 2006; Phelan et al. 2008
JON->GF mixed synapse modelled as electrical; shakB-dependent (Pezier et al. 2016); mixed (Pezier et al. 2014); 3 mV target untraced; contact set from MaleCNS v1.0
JON->GF mixed synapse modelled as electrical; shakB-dependent (Pezier et al. 2016); mixed (Pezier et al. 2014); 3 mV target untraced; contact set from MaleCNS v1.0
intrinsic: all-or-none GF response; von Reyn 2014; Ache 2019. Fitted by pre-stated rule (smallest value giving 1-2 spikes/response, <=2 on the strongest gain quartile, P(response) 0.5-1, TTMn relay intact; benchmarks/fit_gf_adapt.py at >=40 trials). 45 mV at w_scale 0.4 with the per-GF JON calibration (refit 2026-10-11, cloud run 13, 40 trials; the strong-quartile constraint holds at exactly 2.0, its limit; 30 mV gives 2.75). Before: 10 mV at w_scale 0.3 (2026-10-10), 30 mV under the all-trials loom input, 15 mV from an undersampled 20-trial fit. 0 mV gives up to 10 spikes per loom.
sustained MN rates < 100 Hz; Azevedo 2020; McKellar 2020

supersedes.why: model refrozen: the JON -> GF compound potential is calibrated per giant fiber on its own coupled afferents (run 12 measured 3.65 and 0.73 mV for a 3 mV target); w_scale 0.3 -> 0.4, the value the registered benchmark-blind rule selects (fit/select_wscale.py); the giant fiber adaptation refit under both (benchmarks/fit_gf_adapt.py). Criteria unchanged.
